profile.model: Third Rock incubates companies in-house: partners evaluate emerging science in areas of unmet need, then spend an extended seed period validating mechanisms and maturing a lead program before a public launch. Partners often take interim executive and R&D roles at launch, then hand off to recruited management while staying on the board.
profile.summary: One of the most prolific Boston-based biotech company builders, it reports more than 70 companies launched and contributions to 27 approved products. Its alumni include Agios, bluebird bio, Foundation Medicine, Blueprint, MyoKardia and Relay, and it continues to launch several companies a year.
